//: The first plugin (SPA-191, sdk-3): a fixture, not a product — one `action` job that echoes its input, a real manifest authored as a TS const, and the build every plugin reuses (`@spaces/sdk/build`). Its one dependency is @spaces/sdk. effect and zod are peers, not dependencies, because that is what they are: the bundle leaves them as bare imports and the host resolves them to its own copies at load (sdk-11), so a plugin never ships a second Effect. `src/build.test.ts` builds it and checks both emitted files.
